summary: Frontend-only navbar overlap regression tests across Vendor/Employee/Admin at 1920, 1280, 900, 390 widths. Vendor Dashboard: no overlap at 1920 (13px gap between nav-group-more right=948 and outlet-switcher left=961) but REAL overlap at 1280 where nav-group-more (right=653) intersects outlet-switcher (left=616, y-overlap present) — visually confirmed in screenshot. Employee Dashboard fully fixed (no overlaps at 1920 or 1280). Admin regression unaffected. Dropdowns (outlets/menu/more) open correctly, outlet-switcher preserves value, mobile hamburger appears <lg and drawer works, no horizontal overflow at any tested viewport. Note: reported overlap between 'outlet-switcher' and 'outlet-switcher-select' is a nested-elements false positive (select is child of switcher container).

ui_bugs.issue: At desktop width 1280x800, the left top-level nav cluster still overlaps the right controls: nav-group-more bounding box (x=553..653, y=19..59) intersects outlet-switcher (x=616..788, y=21..61). Screenshot confirms the 'More' caret is visually covered by the outlet-switcher dropdown arrow. The fix (raising breakpoint md->lg + flex-shrink-0) is insufficient at 1280 because the vendor has 2 static links (Dashboard, Orders) + 3 groups (Outlets, Menu, More) + right cluster (bell, outlet switcher ~172px, alerts button, TZ Operator label ~120px, logout) — cumulative width exceeds 1280 available px at the desktop breakpoint. At 1920 there is a comfortable 13px gap so it looks fine.

action_items: Vendor navbar still overlaps at 1280px (lg breakpoint = 1024px in Tailwind default). Options: (a) raise vendor-specific breakpoint from lg to xl for the desktop nav, OR (b) reduce right-cluster width at lg (hide the 'Enable alerts' pill and user-role subtitle until xl, or move 'TZ Operator / Vendor' text behind an avatar-only trigger), OR (c) shorten the outlet-switcher (icon-only trigger with dropdown at lg), OR (d) merge Outlets+Menu+More into fewer groups for vendor operators. Verify no overlap at both 1280 and 1366 after fix.
Employee dashboard is fine — no change needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.js: The desktop nav breakpoint is lg (1024px) but vendor with 5 top items + heavy right cluster (bell + outlet switcher + alerts pill + role label + logout) requires ~1300+ px. Consider using xl or a min-width media query on vendor-specific nav.
Right controls cluster width (~640px on vendor at 1280) leaves only ~640px for left cluster which needs ~570px — margin too small; single label change can regress it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Overlap detection script measured all [data-testid] rects inside <nav>. Ignore ('outlet-switcher','outlet-switcher-select') pair — the select is nested inside the switcher container so their rects always intersect (not a real overlap). Real overlap to watch: (nav-group-more, outlet-switcher) on vendor at 1280. Employee & admin passed all viewports.
rca of the issue: Vendor navbar left cluster width (Dashboard 122 + Orders 94 + Outlets 116 + Menu 104 + More 100 + gaps ~10 ≈ 570px starting at x≈109) plus right cluster (~640px anchored to right edge) requires >1210px for zero overlap. At 1280 available inner width, they overlap by ~37px. Fix by raising breakpoint to xl for vendor or trimming right cluster (icon-only outlet switcher / hide role subtitle until xl).
